DitherDropdownMenu.items: The rows. Each has text, shortcut, destructive, disabled, group (a heading above the item) and divider (a line above the item).
DitherDropdownMenu.variant: Highlight of the active item: pill, dither, glow, hatched, dotted or outline.
DitherDropdownMenu.menu: The look of the menu box. card has a dithered glow in the corner, glow a soft glow from the middle, pixel sharper corners and a stronger border, and solid a near-black background.
DitherDropdownMenu.color: Colour of the highlights and the glow.
DitherDropdownMenu.is-open: Whether the menu is open. Read only.
DitherDropdownMenu.selected: The index of the item that was chosen last. Read only.
